onsiteTicket.question: Q. Can I buy a ticket on site on the day of the event?
onsiteTicket.answer: No, we do not take registrations on site.

attendanceCertificate.question: Q. How do I get a certificate of attendance?
attendanceCertificate.answer: Enter the details needed for the certificate when you buy your ticket. We will confirm your attendance and send the certificate within a week after the event.

onsiteTicket.question: Q. Can I buy a ticket on site on the day of the event?
onsiteTicket.answer: No. All tickets are sold online only and cannot be purchased on site on the day of the event.

groupPurchase.question: Q. Can I buy tickets as a group?
groupPurchase.answer: There is no separate group purchase option, but you can buy up to 10 tickets at a time. Please split larger orders into several purchases.

attendanceCertificate.question: Q. How do I get a certificate of attendance?
attendanceCertificate.answer: On the ticket detail screen of the site you booked through, tap the [⋮] button to the right of the ticket to issue a certificate of attendance.
